title: Agreement for the Joint Use of Facilities - District and County of Alameda - Public Health Department - Administration of COVID-19 Vaccines - Chief Systems and Services Officer
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for the Joint Use of Facilities between District and County of Alameda, acting by and through its Alameda County Public Health Department (ACPHD), for the joint use of facilities owned by the District to administer COVID-19 vaccines, as follows:
1.	Fremont High School (4610 Foothill Blvd, Oakland, CA 94601)
2.	United For Success Academy/Life Academy (2101 35th Ave, Oakland, CA 94601)
3.	Elmhurst United Middle School (1800 98th Ave, Oakland, CA 94603)
4.	Urban Promise Academy (3031 E 18th St, Oakland, CA 94601)
5.	Castlemont High School (8601 MacArthur Blvd, Oakland, CA 94605)
6.	Coliseum College Prep Academy (1390 66th Ave, Oakland, CA 94621)
7.	Any other Facilities mutually agreed upon in writing between the Parties; and
pursuant to terms and conditions stated in Agreement, for the term February 1, 2021 through December 31, 2021.
headline: Lets Alameda County use six school sites to give COVID-19 vaccines through 2021
summary: This agreement lets the Alameda County Public Health Department use district-owned facilities to give COVID-19 vaccines. Six schools are named, and other sites can be added if both sides agree in writing. It runs from February 1 to December 31, 2021, and the item lists no cost to the district.
vendor_name: County of Alameda, Alameda County Public Health Department
schools: Fremont High School; United For Success Academy/Life Academy; Elmhurst United Middle School; Urban Promise Academy; Castlemont High School; Coliseum College Prep Academy
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
